SUMMARY
Server-side engineer focused on resilient, measurable systems.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
- Designed resource-oriented HTTP endpoints and service-oriented components.
- Reworked a multi-node event-processing platform using a durable message broker, an in-memory key-value store, and a relational SQL engine.
- Sustained 18,000 requests per second with p95 response time below 45 ms during peak settlement windows.
- Built parallel worker pools, race-safe state transitions, and non-blocking I/O pipelines.
- Modelled relational schemas, access paths, and atomic commit boundaries; reduced a report from 11 minutes to 24 seconds through query-plan analysis.
- Led incident root-cause analysis, production remediation, and response-time tuning using flame graphs and load tests.
- Designed payment authorization, reconciliation, and settlement workflows for ledger operations.

SELECTED PROJECTS
- Migrated a legacy batch process to continuously flowing event handlers with replay support and atomic state updates.
- Processed 40 million records per day while preserving auditability and failure recovery.
